chapters.title: Update a yarn price and inspect its history
chapters.description: Find the demo yarns, inspect their linked quality, change the weft rate from Rs 128 to Rs 140/kg, add a supplier note, and save. Open Activity to review the recorded change.

chapters.title: Use the updated linked quality
chapters.description: Reopen the saved quality and inspect its updated weft rate. Apply the recipe, check the yarn inputs, then review the recalculated live cost.

chapters.title: Earlier costings keep their original figures
chapters.description: Open the earlier saved costing. Its production cost remains Rs 33.23/m and its suggested price remains Rs 39.09/m. Updating Rate Book does not rewrite historical snapshots.

narration.speaker: Neha
narration.description: Neha speaks at a moderate pace in a clear, calm, slightly expressive voice. The recording is very high quality, with very clear audio, no background noise and a close-sounding voice.
